mentions.name: Woodworking simulator game
mentions.description: This is a woodworking simulator game that aims to capture the satisfying feeling of sawing, chiselling, and hammering wood pieces (jointing) into a usable object. The sawing mechanic is complete, with chiseling planned next and jointing being the hard part. It is prototyped in Rust using raylib and JoltPhysics without a game engine, and the author avoids AI for coding beyond brainstorming and isolated functions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm prototyping a wood-working simulator game in my free time for a year now, here is its latest short https://phqb.github.io/woodsim-short-15-07-2026.html.

My goal is to capture the satisfying feeling of sawing & chiselling wood and hammering its parts (jointing) into an usable object.

Now sawing mechanic is done, chiseling shouldn't be a problem. Jointing will be hard.
mentions.author: phqb
